description: This file defines a GUI component for displaying and interacting with a behavioral coding map, including loading a bitmap, drawing polygons, and handling user input to select areas.

classes.name: ModifiersCodingMapWindow
classes.description: Main dialog window for displaying and editing a behavioral coding map with polygon areas.

classes.name: ModifiersCodingMapWindow.View
classes.description: Custom QGraphicsView subclass that emits a signal on mouse press.

methods.name: viewMousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events on the view, toggling area codes based on clicked polygons.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Returns the current area codes as a string.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads the bitmap and polygon areas from the coding map data and displays them.
